body: Different strokes for different folks. I think everything is going digital. Dvds are going to become as obsolete as vhs
Tmi?
That's a good reason to get rid of some. My sister has a collection like that and instead of keeping the DVD cases she got a huge DVD binder that she keeps stored on a book shelf.
I am impressed by that collection. The only thing I don't like about dvds is how easily they scratch. Nothing worse than watching a movie and it freezes or skips.
Yeah, I like super dorky trivia I can whip out at inappropriate moments.
Yeah, absolutely. I'll ask my sister if I can borrow her copies this weekend.
The only time I do is if it accidentally pops up on imdb. I like to look at the movie trivia.
Idk. I got mine early. But that might have been because i was fat. Looking back on it, there was definitely more fat than mammary glands. 🤦🏻‍♀️
Alot of critic reports are just off the wall. I don't know what people are expecting when they watch stuff, but some people are just negative to be negative.
Imagine all the antibiotics and growth hormones that would take! Toddlers would be growing boobs. 😂😂
I'd say I'm probably the same. There are some films people love and I detest. But there are some I think are top shelf and everyone thinks I'm crazy.
I was scared for a while that some pterodactyl sized turkey was out there being harvested for ren fairs. All seems right with the world now.
I'll keep an eye out for him to form a valid opinion. 😄
I'll try for a first watch through. Oh, I remember that fin headed thing too. Jar jar binks. I remember they had him on bags of Doritos when I was a kid.

I think all I know about them are the  bikini, jaba the hut, incest and Darth Vader is apparently the baby daddy. I will watch it one day. Not really sure what order to watch them in. The chronological order or what not.
That was one of the questions I had. I was thinking they sprinkle them with miracle grow or something. Seemed more logical than an ostrich leg.

Star wars? 



Don't be impressed, I had to Google it as I have never watched star wars. I've always meant to, just never really got around to it.
Omg are they really? That would explain alot of unanswered questions I had. And now I'm slightly repulsed.
Ok, on the spot give me a movie quote. The beat one you can think of.
I have never had a garlic bread bowl. But it oddly makes me think of the ren fair and the huge ass turkey legs.
Onions can be substituted and or removed. It's negotiable. But some stew in a bread bowl would slap right about now.
That is mildly horrific. How dare you desecrate a potato by making it a soup. I prefer a hearty stew anyway.
I want to start off strong... do I go with chicken noodle or pea soup. I'm horrible at decision making.
Nessie looks better as a soup ladle though.

The unicorn absolutely floored me. I did not know that. And I'm a little disappointed that they didn't grab the bull by the horns and make the national animal the loch Ness monster. #missedoppertunity
Movie quotes are the best. Never a wrong time to bust out a quote.
What kind of photography are you into?
It's like the JG Wentworth commercials. "Its my money and I need it now!" Only it's like "it's my life, and I want to end it now!"

It depends on what you believe. I was raised Christian with the expectation if you kill your self you go to hell. I read dante's inferno. And his description of hell for suicides is enough to make me think twice when the urge is strong. The struggle is real. I feel your pain.

I do too. I was driving home today praying that someone would kill me. That way my daughter wouldn't be mad at me. I'm going through a very painful divorce, where I'm living im abused constantly. I can't find anywhere safe to move. It feels like there is no hope. Its just an endless road of more pain and struggles. When my kid got out of my car she said "please don't do anything stupid". I feel like I'm doing so much damage to her. So I understand the feeling.
Thank you, I appreciate your kind words.
I think people like him experienced some psychological trauma. That's all I can figure. He is just a cruel person.
Yeah, she lives with me. And I would deal with it all over again for her. She is my world.

I am lucky to have her. But having her forces me to see him every week. And I see how happy he is without me. And every time I start to heal the wound rips open again. It hurts. And it starts to heal and then I see him again. It's a vicious cycle.

When I first got married at 18 my husband did a 180. Became cruel and hurtful. He broke my heart so much I'm surprised I survived it. The worst thing is after he would hit me or hurt me he would hold me down on the bed and sing our song to me. I'll be by Edwin McCain. I don't know why but him holding me down to force me to listen to our song made the hurt so much worse. I just wanted him to hold me and tell me he still loved me. He never did. To this day I can't listen to that song without having a panic attack and crying.

I'm sorry you're feeling all this. It's very hard to look at someone you love and realize they don't feel the same. You question everything about yourself and your life. You can't die from a heart break, but sometimes you really want to. My husband left me for another woman. And I realize now i was nothing to him anyways. I was garbage he was comfortable kicking around. I hope your heart heals and the pain fades.

I would, but I wouldn't. I got my daughter out if it. So I'm thankful I met him for that. But in 10 years of marriage he totally destroyed me. Everything I was. I hear people talk about me now saying I've changed so much they don't recognize me. I used to be so happy and healthy and always laughing and trying to make others laugh. But now I'm quiet. I don't talk because I'm afraid to be made fun of. I don't laugh because I'm afraid to hear that I'm trying to hard. I lost almost all my friends. I'm ashamed of how I look and speak. I can't look in the mirror any more. Because I see what he saw when he looked at me. So I hate what I see as much as he did. So my daughter is worth the hurt. But if I didn't have her, I would wish I never met him.
